title: How I work
seo_title: How I work: four stages, one developer | Chris Garlick
seo_description: You talk to the person who writes the code, from the first call to the handover. Audit and plan, scope in writing, design then build, tested and handed over.

data.eyebrow: How I work · one developer, four stages
data.title:
AI DOES
THE TYPING.
*I do the thinking.*
data.lede: You talk to the person who writes the code, from the first call to the handover. AI does the typing; I do the thinking, the tests and the review.

data.title: FOUR *stages*
data.body: Each one ends with something you can see and sign off.

data.title:
WHAT'S WRONG,
*agreed first.*
data.body: I audit what you have with Kritano, then map the pages, flows and data on a board you can comment on.

image.alt: An example Kritano audit: overall health 87, scores for SEO, accessibility, security, performance and content, and the top findings

data.caption: Fig. 01 · a Kritano audit, the starting point

data.title:
YOU KNOW WHAT
*done* LOOKS LIKE.
data.body: A written scope: what's in, what's out, how it's tested and what done looks like. The timeline and price come with it, in the proposal. You sign off before anything is built.
data.card_title:
**01** What's in
**02** What's out
**03** How it's tested
**04** What done looks like
**05** The price, in the proposal
data.card_text: Signed off before anything is built

data.title:
SOMETHING
WORKING,
*every week.*
data.body: Every page designed and signed off first, then built in small releases you can click through each week.

image.alt: The cg-cms admin dashboard at chrisgarlick.com: alerts, published and draft counts, leads this week, page cache warmth and recent articles

data.caption: Fig. 03 · the cg-cms admin, my own Laravel CMS

data.title:
DOCUMENTED,
*handed over.*
data.body: Automated tests, written documentation and a clear deployment, so you always know how it works and what it runs on.
data.card_label: Time to first byte · cached page, live 1GB server
data.card_text: Measured, with the method written down

data.title:
WHERE AI IS,
*and where it isn't.*
data.body: Claude Code, Board, Design, Motion and Typeset let one person deliver like a small team. The judgement stays with me.

points.text: Drafting code and tests, which I review line by line.
Turning the plan into designs, visuals and documents faster.
